title: Specification - Model Context Protocol
snippet: The protocol specification for connecting LLM applications to external tools and data sources: base protocol, lifecycle, transports (stdio, Streamable HTTP), authorization, and server features such as tools, resources and prompts.

title: A2A Protocol (GitHub: a2aproject/A2A)
snippet: An open protocol for communication and interoperability between opaque agentic applications: agent cards for discovery, tasks with streaming updates, and push notifications.

title: Agent Development Kit documentation
snippet: A framework for developing and deploying AI agents: tools, multi-agent systems, sessions and memory, callbacks and plugins, evaluation, and deployment options.

title: LiteLLM (GitHub: BerriAI/litellm)
snippet: A Python SDK and proxy server to call many LLM APIs in the OpenAI format, with routing, fallbacks, spend tracking and rate limiting across providers.

title: gVisor: application kernel for containers
snippet: An application kernel that implements a Linux-like interface in user space, giving containers an extra isolation boundary from the host kernel.

title: Semantic conventions for generative AI systems - OpenTelemetry
snippet: Attribute and span conventions for recording LLM calls, agent operations and tool executions, including token usage and model names.

title: React Blog
snippet: Release announcements and updates for the React JavaScript library for building user interfaces.
